hook.name: ClankerHookStaticFeeV2
hook.description: Clanker protocol hook for token launch pools with asymmetric buy/sell LP fees configured at initialization. Dynamically updates fees per swap via updateDynamicLPFee, collects protocol fees by manipulating BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta, and supports a temporary MEV-protection module that can raise fees for the first 2 minutes after pool creation.
